channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Kherson Region Truce Extended Without Violations
item.description: Authorities confirm the extension of a local ceasefire in Ukraine's Kherson area, initially set for trapped civilians in Oleshky. Both Ukrainian and Russian sides report that the truce has held without any violations.

item.title: Manufacturing Accelerator Re:Build Secures $2.1B
item.description: Re:Build, a manufacturing firm that originated from Slate Auto, has secured $2.1 billion in funding. The company positions itself as an American alternative to Shenzhen's industrial ecosystem.

item.title: দম্পতির ওপর হামলার অভিযোগ, থানায় মামলা না নেওয়ার দাবি
item.description: গাজীপুরের কুনা এলাকায় একটি বাসায় এক দম্পতিকে কুপিয়ে ও পিটিয়ে জখম করা হয়েছে। ৯৯৯-এ কল পেয়ে পুলিশ তাঁদের হাসপাতালে পাঠালেও থানায় মামলা রেকর্ড করা হয়নি বলে ভুক্তভোগীদের অভিযোগ।

item.title: মেট্রোরেলে যাত্রীর মৃত্যু, বসার আসন না পাওয়ার অভিযোগ
item.description: অতিরিক্ত ভিড়ের মধ্যে মেট্রো রেলে দাঁড়িয়ে অসুস্থ হয়ে পড়েন ৬৪ বছর বয়সী নজীবুর রহমান। আসন ছাড়ার অনুরোধে কেউ সাড়া না দেওয়ায় তিনি মেঝেতে পড়ে মারা যান বলে পরিবারের অভিযোগ।

item.title: Petitioners Ask Supreme Court to Preserve SIR Files
item.description: Appellants have formally requested the Supreme Court to mandate the safeguarding of all related SIR documents and internal notes. The legal plea focuses on maintaining the integrity of these records.

item.title: Israeli Exit Polls Show Inconclusive Election Outcome
item.description: Recent exit polls following the Israeli elections demonstrate that no clear victor has emerged. Final and official election outcomes are scheduled for release on November 4.

item.title: ২০৩০ সালের মধ্যে ১০ হাজার মেগাওয়াট নবায়নযোগ্য জ্বালানির লক্ষ্য
item.description: বিদ্যুৎমন্ত্রী ইকবাল হাসান মাহমুদ টুকু জানিয়েছেন, সরকার ২০৩০ সালের মধ্যে নবায়নযোগ্য উৎস থেকে ১০ হাজার মেগাওয়াট বিদ্যুৎ উৎপাদনের লক্ষ্য ঠিক করেছে। খাতটির প্রসারে এই পরিকল্পনা বাস্তবায়ন করা হবে।

item.title: Arsenal and Fleetwood Carabao Cup Match Interrupted by Drone
item.description: The Carabao Cup round of 16 fixture between Arsenal and Fleetwood Town faced an eight-minute stoppage. Play was paused after an unauthorized drone appeared over the venue.

item.title: Mitchell Starc Reflects on Recent Bowling Form
item.description: The Australian pace bowler admitted his performances during the recent series felt off. After reviewing match recordings, he concluded that he had unnecessarily complicated his approach.

item.title: Australian Politics Updates: Greens Tax Proposal and eSafety Remarks
item.description: The Australian Greens have suggested a tax adjustment aimed at saving residents $1,000 annually. Meanwhile, the eSafety commissioner compared social media platforms to a Roman gladiator arena.

item.title: Actor Jake Gyllenhaal Sells New York Condominium for $14 Million
item.description: Actor Jake Gyllenhaal parted ways with his New York City apartment for $14 million, having originally purchased the property for $8.63 million, amid a pending $376 million legal action.

item.title: San Diego Student Wins $25,000 for Wearable Stethoscope Invention
item.description: Twelfth-grader Kayley Xu created Aucura, a wearable medical device meant to improve respiratory checks. The student was inspired to innovate the traditional stethoscope after recovering from pneumonia.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab Strikes Eastern India With Heavy Rain
item.description: Cyclone Arnab made landfall across the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coastal regions. Meteorological authorities reported heavy downpours affecting eastern states as the system moved through.

item.title: নায়ক মান্নার ব্যবহৃত গাড়িতে আগুনের ঘটনায় গ্রেপ্তার দুজন কারাগারে
item.description: Prothom Alo-এর প্রতিবেদন অনুযায়ী, রাজধানীর বসুন্ধরা আবাসিক এলাকায় প্রয়াত চিত্রনায়ক মান্নার ব্যবহৃত একটি গাড়ি মেরামতের সময় অগ্নিকাণ্ডের ঘটনায় গ্রেপ্তার দুজনকে কারাগারে পাঠিয়েছেন আদালত। পুলিশের আবেদনের পরিপ্রেক্ষিতে মঙ্গলবার ঢাকার মেট্রোপলিটন ম্যাজিস্ট্রেট আমিনুল ইসলাম জুনাইদ এ আদেশ দেন। কারাগা…। এ ঘটনায় আলোচিত: মান্নার, ব্যবহৃত, ঘটনায়, গ্রেপ্তার।

item.title: Olivia Chow Wins Second Term as Toronto Mayor
item.description: Incumbent Toronto Mayor Olivia Chow secured re-election in a competitive race against Conservative opponent Brad Bradford. Her platform focused on affordable rentals, free school meals, and transit discounts.

item.title: Israeli Exit Polls Indicate Indecisive Election Outcome
item.description: Early exit polls from the Israeli election show no single faction securing a definitive victory. Both Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his opponents failed to achieve a governing majority.

item.title: Imprisoned Tanzanian politician Tundu Lissu stops hunger strike
item.description: Tanzanian opposition figure Tundu Lissu halted his recent food refusal. He is currently facing a treason accusation that could result in capital punishment and had initially boycotted meals following restricted legal counsel access.

item.title: Boeing Shares Drop 9 Percent Amid 737 Max Output Delay
item.description: Boeing equity fell nine percent following the manufacturer's announcement that 737 Max output will not scale up substantially until late 2027. The disclosure precedes a scheduled investor briefing on quarterly financial results.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab Approaches Andhra Pradesh Coast
item.description: On October 27, 2026, Cyclone Arnab moved toward Andhra Pradesh, causing anxiety in Kakinada. Southern districts of Odisha also began experiencing rainfall as the storm advanced.

item.title: Israeli vote exit surveys show tied outcome
item.description: Voting concluded at 10 p.m. local time during Israel's critical national ballot. The election featured strong participation as long-serving leader Benjamin Netanyahu fought to maintain his political career amid projected stalemate results.

item.title: Severe weather halts transport in Andhra Pradesh ahead of cyclone
item.description: As Cyclone Arnab approaches land, Andhra Pradesh has halted numerous transport services and docked 30,000 fishing vessels. Meanwhile, neighboring Odisha has initiated large-scale evacuations and restricted travel routes.

item.title: Zookeeper in the Netherlands killed inside leopard habitat
item.description: A female zoo employee suffered fatal injuries after being attacked within a leopard enclosure. She had spent roughly 40 years intermittently working at the facility, having started at age 17.

item.title: General Motors plans transition from NYSE to Nasdaq on Nov 17
item.description: GM will retain its existing 'GM' stock symbol during the move to Nasdaq. The automaker stated that investors do not need to perform any steps for the exchange.

item.title: Programmer Ondrej Sury discusses avoiding digital threat
item.description: Broadcaster Tech Life features software developer Ondrej Sury. The programmer explains how his updates to PHP prevented a major technological security emergency.

item.title: JetBlue Reports Higher Financial Loss Due to Fuel Expenses
item.description: JetBlue Airways recorded an increased financial loss driven by rising fuel expenses. Despite this, the chief executive officer noted that company margins are showing signs of progress under a current restructuring strategy.

item.title: Communist Party of India protests for Election Commissioner exit
item.description: CPI members organized a human chain protest in Delhi to demand the removal of the Chief Election Commissioner and the cancellation of the SIR. Party leader D. Raja argued the official compromised public trust and electoral integrity.

item.title: Qatari Emir and Putin advocate dialogue during US-Iran tensions
item.description: Russian leader Vladimir Putin and Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani held discussions in Moscow. Both leaders emphasized the necessity of diplomatic solutions regarding ongoing tensions between the United States and Iran.

item.title: Anthropic flags bioweapon and autonomy risks before public offering
item.description: Ahead of its IPO, Anthropic warned about autonomous AI actions, bioweapon threats, and potential legal liabilities. The firm also highlighted challenges related to data center opposition and employee reactions to safety choices.

item.title: Jan Suraaj Secures Initial Bihar Council Victory
item.description: Out of eight contested Bihar Legislative Council positions, the ruling NDA is poised to capture five. Meanwhile, independent candidates secured two seats, and Jan Suraaj claimed one victory following recent by-elections.

item.title: সরকার ডিজিটাল খাতে ১০ লাখ চাকরি তৈরির পরিকল্পনা করছে
item.description: আগামী পাঁচ বছরের মধ্যে তথ্যপ্রযুক্তি খাতে ১০ লাখ নতুন চাকরি সৃষ্টি এবং বাংলাদেশকে এআই ও প্রযুক্তির আঞ্চলিক হাব বানানোর পরিকল্পনা নিয়ে কাজ করছে প্রশাসন। ডাক, টেলিযোগাযোগ ও তথ্যপ্রযুক্তিমন্ত্রী ফকির মাহবুব আনাম সম্প্রতি এই বিষয়টি জানিয়েছেন।

item.title: BRICS Parliamentary Group Voices Concern Over West Asia
item.description: Participants at the BRICS parliamentary forum issued a joint statement highlighting serious worry regarding ongoing conflict in West Asia. The declaration advocates for a two-state resolution and acknowledges Palestinian sovereignty and self-determination.

item.title: India-Russia Ties Face Strain From Balancing Approach
item.description: New Delhi's diplomatic balancing act threatens to diminish Moscow's confidence in the relationship. This performative strategy may ultimately damage the historic partnership between the two nations.

item.title: Israeli Election Update: Eisenkot Alliance Leads Netanyahu
item.description: Voter turnout was notably strong in what many view as a pivotal election for Israel. Current tallies indicate that the faction led by Eisenkot holds an advantage over Netanyahu's supporters.

item.title: Is AI making you lazier?
item.description: As reported by Live Science, A new study revealed that people who rely on AI for basic tasks like math problems became less motivated over time. Key points: Live Science, making, lazier, study.

item.title: Houthis Claim Ballistic Missile Attack on Saudi Ministry and Refinery
item.description: Houthi forces stated they executed a direct hit on a Saudi ministry using a ballistic missile. They also reported targeting the Ras Tanura oil refinery near the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Rockstar workers in the UK will hold a union vote just as GTA 6 is released
item.description: As reported by Engadget, A legal case alleging union. Key points: Rockstar, union, rockstar, workers.

item.title: Netanyahu's Party Seeks Voting Hours Extension
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's political party requested an extension for voting hours in Israel. This request comes as the country experiences record voter turnout during the election.

item.title: Trump Says He Will Respect Midterm Election Results "If Polls Are Honest"
item.description: As reported by NDTV, His remarks come as the President has intensified his focus on election integrity ahead of the midterm polls. Key points: Trump Says He Will Respect Midterm Election Results, If Polls Are Honest, President, Congress.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh coast hit by Cyclone Arnab landfall and rain
item.description: Cyclone Arnab has begun hitting the coast of Andhra Pradesh, bringing powerful winds and heavy rainfall. Emergency services are maintaining a high state of readiness to mitigate potential damage.

item.title: ন্যাশনাল ওলামা অ্যালায়েন্সে নতুন দায়িত্ব পেলেন যারা
item.description: মাওলানা সানাউল্লাহ খানের পদত্যাগ গ্রহণের পর ন্যাশনাল ওলামা অ্যালায়েন্সের ভারপ্রাপ্ত সদস্যসচিব হয়েছেন মুফতি ইনজিমামুল ইসলাম। একই সঙ্গে সংগঠনটির ভারপ্রাপ্ত সাংগঠনিক সম্পাদকের দায়িত্ব পেয়েছেন মুফতি মাহমুদ হাসান।

item.title: Musk alleges Ukraine breached Starlink usage guidelines
item.description: Billionaire Elon Musk stated that Ukrainian forces breached Starlink's user agreement. He asserted that the satellite network was utilized for offensive drone operations.

item.title: US Health Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr makes disputed claim on Arabs
item.description: United States Health Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr asserted that the Arab world has not contributed to literature, mathematics, or science.

item.title: Nigerian probe finds Minna detention facility deaths preventable
item.description: An official investigation concluded that the deaths of 33 inmates inside a Minna detention unit could have been avoided. The fatalities resulted from severe congestion and inadequate airflow.

item.title: Renowned classical dancer Sreedevi Rajan dies at 84
item.description: Prominent dancer Sreedevi Rajan has died at the age of 84.

item.title: Rajasthan faces severe river pollution from industrial waste
item.description: Discharge of industrial waste into waterways in Rajasthan highlights administrative shortcomings in pollution control.

item.title: Trump states he will accept midterm outcomes if fair
item.description: Donald Trump stated that he will acknowledge the outcome of the upcoming November 3 midterm polls provided the process is fair.

item.title: Long Beach Home Features Automated Halloween Display
item.description: Jeff and Ann Haberman put on an annual Halloween exhibition in Long Beach featuring synchronized illumination and musical numbers. A network of 28 computers controls the complex animated production.

item.title: Reports Claim Flavio Bolsonaro Left Brazil After Election
item.description: According to reports, Flavio Bolsonaro departed Brazil shortly following the presidential election defeat. Law enforcement lacks official documentation of his departure, and associates stated they could not reach him on Tuesday.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Expected to Need 210GB Storage Space
item.description: Players will need to allocate a substantial amount of storage on their gaming systems for Grand Theft Auto VI. Reports indicate the title will demand a 210GB download.

item.title: Google Opens Applications for Android App Stores Program
item.description: Google is initiating its Registered App Stores program on December 1, with application submissions currently open. The initiative aims to streamline software installation via approved alternative marketplaces.

item.title: Ladakh Administration Engages With Alcohol Ban Demonstrators
item.description: Authorities in Ladakh have initiated contact with demonstrators who are calling for a prohibition on alcohol. The outreach addresses the ongoing protests concerning the liquor ban demand.

item.title: Colin Farrell Foundation Awards Grants to 16 Charities
item.description: The Colin Farrell Foundation has chosen 16 non-profit groups to receive financial awards of up to $50,000. These grants aim to support organizations dedicated to assisting people with developmental and intellectual disabilities.

item.title: SAU Students Protest Secretariat Relocation and Take Equipment
item.description: Students from Sher-e-Bangla Agricultural University protested plans to move the Secretariat to the old trade fair grounds, which they consider university property. During the Tuesday protest, students removed machinery and two vehicles from the site.

item.title: Swapan Ahmed Shoots Pother Bondhu in France
item.description: Filming for Swapan Ahmed's movie Pother Bondhu is underway in France, featuring lead actor Tauquir Ahmed. The production involves collaboration with European crew members sharing their experiences.

item.title: Mumbai civic body threatens builders with penalties over dust control
item.description: Municipal Commissioner Ashwini Bhide stated that real estate developers must manage dust pollution around building projects and nearby streets, warning of severe penalties.

item.title: Twin brothers from Ghana and US woman admit guilt in $9m love scam
item.description: The trio conned older individuals in the US and Europe by faking romantic ties to trick victims into sending massive financial transfers.

item.title: BBC Sports Examines Troubled Ballon d'Or in London
item.description: For the first time in seven decades, the Ballon d'Or ceremony took place in London. BBC Sport reviewed the event, describing the historic evening as particularly chaotic.

item.title: টাঙ্গাইলের দল সেমিফাইনালে
item.description: সানজিদা আক্তারের রাঙ্গাটুঙ্গীকে হারিয়ে মরহুম ফরহাদ হোসেন তালুকদার ফুটবল একাডেমি প্রথম দল হিসেবে সেমিফাইনাল নিশ্চিত করেছে।

item.title: Senator Flavio Bolsonaro travels to the US amid ongoing probe
item.description: According to sources close to Flavio Bolsonaro, the Brazilian senator is traveling to the United States. This follows the cancellation of his passports earlier on Tuesday.

item.title: Tornado hits Turkish building site causing fatalities
item.description: A destructive tornado has hit a building site in Turkey, resulting in deaths.
